description: Return up to 5 distinct shipping addresses from the user's past orders (matched by the account email), newest first. For a returning buyer, call it before asking for an address, show the options, and pass the one they pick to set_shipping_address — this tool only reads and selects nothing. An empty list means no past orders: ask the human for the address.
name: get_saved_addresses

addresses.description: Up to 5 distinct addresses from past orders, newest first.

title: Get saved addresses
